*   Security review is still open on the SSO question.

transcript.speaker: Dan Osei
transcript.text: Thanks for making time. I know the renewal date is coming up fast.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: It is. The number I have in front of me is from the old tier though.

transcript.speaker: Dan Osei
transcript.text: That's on me. I'll send over the updated pricing sheet for the 250 seat tier by Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Appreciated. The other open thing is single sign on.

transcript.text: If the security review passes we could look into migrating to SAML SSO, but nothing is decided on our end.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: That would help. My security lead will want the compliance paperwork too.

transcript.speaker: Dan Osei
transcript.text: SOC 2 Type II report goes to your security team this afternoon, Priya.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Great. Let's talk again once the deep dive happens.

payload.notes:
#### Overview
*   CSV export is timing out for large workspaces.
*   Billing migration is blocked on legal.

actionItems.title: Fix the CSV export timeout
actionItems.description: Ship the patch for the CSV export timeout affecting large workspaces.

actionItems.title: Add a bulk import endpoint
actionItems.description: Add a bulk import endpoint to the API.

actionItems.title: Audit the webhook retry logic
actionItems.description: Audit the webhook retry logic for duplicate deliveries.

actionItems.title: Migrate Volta to the new billing system
actionItems.description: Move the Volta account onto the new billing system.

transcript.speaker: Maya Chen
transcript.text: The big one this week is the export. Anything over about forty thousand rows just hangs.

transcript.speaker: Tom Alvarez
transcript.text: I'll get the CSV export timeout fixed before Friday, I have already got a patch in review.

transcript.speaker: Maya Chen
transcript.text: Perfect. Maybe down the road it'd be nice to have a bulk import endpoint as well, but that is not urgent.

transcript.speaker: Tom Alvarez
transcript.text: Noted. Separately, someone should probably audit the webhook retry logic, maybe Raj can look at it at some point.

transcript.speaker: Raj Patel
transcript.text: I have not seen duplicate deliveries reported recently, but I hear you.

transcript.speaker: Maya Chen
transcript.text: Do we have usage numbers for last quarter? Finance is asking.

transcript.speaker: Tom Alvarez
transcript.text: I'll pull the Q3 usage report and send it Monday.

transcript.speaker: Tom Alvarez
transcript.text: And I'll migrate you to the new billing system next sprint.

transcript.speaker: Tom Alvarez
transcript.text: Actually, scratch that, we are not doing the billing migration until legal signs off on the new terms.

transcript.speaker: Maya Chen
transcript.text: No problem, the current invoicing works fine for us.

payload.name: Support escalation: Volta latency
payload.notes:
#### Overview
*   p99 latency spike since Tuesday.
*   Caching change is a suspect but unconfirmed.

actionItems.title: Root-cause the p99 latency spike
actionItems.description: Find the root cause of the p99 latency spike affecting Volta.

actionItems.title: Roll back the caching change
actionItems.description: Roll back the recent caching change.

actionItems.title: Send a written incident summary
actionItems.description: Send Volta a written incident summary.

actionItems.title: Add latency alerting for Volta's workspace
actionItems.description: Add latency alerting scoped to the Volta workspace.

actionItems.title: Credit Volta for the downtime
actionItems.description: Issue Volta a credit for the downtime.

transcript.speaker: Maya Chen
transcript.text: Since Tuesday our slowest requests have roughly tripled. My team noticed before your status page did.

transcript.speaker: Raj Patel
transcript.text: I'll root cause the p99 latency spike and have an update for you by tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Raj Patel
transcript.text: I'll roll back the caching change we shipped last week.

transcript.speaker: Raj Patel
transcript.text: Hold off on that actually, we need to confirm it is the cause first, a blind rollback could make it worse.

transcript.speaker: Maya Chen
transcript.text: My VP will want something in writing either way.

transcript.speaker: Raj Patel
transcript.text: You'll have a written incident summary from me by Friday.

transcript.speaker: Maya Chen
transcript.text: It would be nice to have latency alerting on our workspace so we hear it from you first. Worth exploring.

transcript.speaker: Raj Patel
transcript.text: If the postmortem shows it was on our side we'll credit you for the downtime.
